mapper.select: SELECT team_id AS teamId, name, league, logo, head_coach, stadium, location from team

SELECT t.team_id, t.name, t.league, t.logo, t.head_coach, t.stadium, t.location, t.club_color, t.founded, t.website, p.player_id, p.team_id, p.name AS player_name, p.nation, p.position, p.birthday FROM team t LEFT JOIN player p ON t.team_id = p.team_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId}
